_comment: Minimum acceptable scores per profile. 'live' is calibrated from the first real run against claude-sonnet-5-5 (2026-10-25, 3 repeats, 50 items): each floor sits a few points under the measured mean, with the margin sized from that metric's observed spread. 'stub' sits just below the keyword analyzer's measured scores -- it is a smoke test that the harness still computes real numbers over the real file, NOT a quality claim. Tolerances are subtracted from the committed baseline before comparing, so run-to-run variance doesn't fail a build.

_measured_2026_10_25._note: Two independent 3-repeat runs. Floors are set under the WORST of the two, not the best -- calibrating to a single lucky run is how a gate starts failing on its own noise. Tolerance is ~2.5x the largest spread seen on any accuracy metric (0.020).

regression_tolerance_overrides._why: severity_mae is ordinal and moves far more between runs than the accuracy metrics (observed spread 0.14 vs 0.0). The global 3-point tolerance would fail the nightly job on ordinary noise, which is how a gate stops being trusted and gets disabled. Sized at roughly 2x the observed spread.
